# InsurancePolicy

A standalone insurance policy entity — life, home, health, motor, travel, pet, or professional indemnity. Life insurance is often the single largest estate asset. Policies written in trust pass outside the estate

Source: [`v3/insurance-policy.json`](../../v3/insurance-policy.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/insurance-policy.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this insurance policy within the INHERIT document |
| `policyType` | one of `life`, `home`, `health`, `motor`, `travel`, `pet`, `professional_indemnity`, `other` or `string` | yes | The type of insurance policy |
| `providerOrganisationId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the Organisation.id of the insurance provider |
| `providerOrganisationIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced provider organisation |
| `policyNumber` | `string` | | The insurance policy number or reference |
| `coverAmount` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Total cover amount (sum assured for life, rebuild cost for home, etc.) in minor currency units |
| `premiumAmount` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Premium amount per payment period, in minor currency units |
| `premiumFrequency` | one of `monthly`, `annual`, `single_premium`, `paid_up`, `other` | | How often premiums are paid |
| `renewalDate` | `string` (date) | | Next renewal date. Important — cover may lapse if not renewed after death |
| `maturityDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the policy matures (for endowment policies and investment-linked policies) |
| `deathBenefit` | `object` | | Death benefit details — what is payable on the policyholder's death, to whom, and how |
| `writtenInTrust` | `boolean` | | Whether the policy is written in trust. If true, proceeds pass outside the estate and are not subject to inheritance tax |
| `trustDetails` | `object` | | Details of the trust holding this policy, if writtenInTrust is true |
| `claimStatus` | one of `active`, `claim_submitted`, `claim_approved`, `claim_paid`, `claim_disputed`, `pending`, `approved`, `paid`, `declined` | | Current status of any claim against this policy |
| `externalPolicyRef` | `string` (uri) | | URI pointing to an external policy record (FHIR Coverage resource, or any external insurance management system) |
| `nominationLifecycle` | `object` | | Lifecycle tracking for policy nominations — tracks the current nomination status and any superseding nominations |
| `policyConditions` | array of `object` | | Conditions, exclusions, or clauses that affect the policy — e.g. suicide clause, contestability period, pre-existing condition exclusions |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this insurance policy |
| `funeralPlanDetails` | `object` | | Details specific to funeral plan insurance |
| `depositorProtection` | `object` | | Financial compensation scheme protection status. In the UK, the FSCS protects insurance policyholders if the insurer fails. Knowing whether a policy is protected matters for estate risk assessment |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
